exposure: mass-media campaign ('No to unnecessary caesarean sections')
outcome: knowledge about benefits of vaginal birth and risks of CS
cohort: A random sample of 702 eligible pregnant women attending 37 public and private maternity care centers in Tehran, Iran.
finding: The mass-media campaign significantly improved pregnant women's knowledge, attitude, and intention towards vaginal birth.
mod_finding: Women who saw the campaign reported increased behavioral intention toward vaginal birth, indicating a positive shift towards vaginal delivery intention.
cross-section timing: Measurements taken before and after the 10-day mass-media campaign.
